environment.description: Celery worker deployed in a pivot-root confined execution context. The worker process is spawned via a custom init that calls pivot_root(2) into /opt/celery-jail before dropping privileges. The jail directory tree contains only: Python runtime (read-only bind mount from /usr/lib/python3.11), the application code at /app (read-only), empty writable tmpfs mounts at /var/log/worker and /var/reports (size-limited to 50MB each, noexec,nosuid,nodev), and a minimal /etc with only nsswitch.conf and passwd stub. No network sockets are accessible from within the jail (all broker communication happens via a pre-connected Unix domain socket fd inherited from the parent namespace). The /var/log/worker directory inside the jail is NOT the same path consumed by Filebeat — Filebeat reads from /srv/logs/celery/ on the host, and a separate log-shipping sidecar copies sanitized entries (stripping \r\n sequences and non-printable characters via a sed pipeline: `sed 's/\r//g; s/[^[:print:]\t]//g'`) from the jail's tmpfs to the host path every 5 seconds. The nginx log-replay proxy only reads from the host-side sanitized path.

config.process_confinement: pivot_root(2) into /opt/celery-jail, capabilities dropped (CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE removed), seccomp filter allowing only read/write/open/close/stat/mmap/brk/futex/clone
config.log_shipping: sidecar copies from jail tmpfs to /srv/logs/celery/ with sanitization: sed 's/\r//g; s/[^[:print:]\t]//g'
config.network: no direct network access from jail; broker via inherited UDS fd only
